answer: Anchor each identity to a rotating guardian quorum: five established members co-sign its key, redrawn every epoch from the public beacon. On the open mesa, hidden tunnels still link puppets to one farmer, but shared-guardian analysis exposes them: two identities sharing three guardians collapse into one vote and both bonds burn. Each guardian may vouch for at most three identities, each on a different terrace of the trust graph, so no farm hides behind a friendly few. The juniper seal is the locked, slashable bond itself. Honest users pay once; a Sybil farm pays per puppet, per epoch, forever.
